items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: he, Jolly liked Zutty... And Jolly wrote me

ctx.x: I just noticed that Zutty played drums on all those General Sats, too.
Yeah, he was there. Well, he, Jolly liked Zutty, he was playing.
And he had one session, he used Fred Robinson on the trombone.
